scope: Topology-only control from H18-R1.2 SAME-BUILD pre/post, not a from-raw graph builder
edge_selection: For each u, take d_post(u) nearest pregraph out-neighbors by squared L2; tie by ascending ID
limitations: No claims about improved search quality or build performance.
Changing topology may reduce connectivity; measure exact Recall/QPS on same native searcher.
This is nearest-only matched-degree control, not novel graph construction.
Only one stochastic SIFT1M pre/post pair.
